name: seven-of-nine
reference_text: Today, Ensign Kim and I will conduct a comprehensive diagnostic of the aft sensor array. I have allocated 3 hours 20 minutes for the task, and an additional 17 minutes for Ensign Kim's usual conversational digressions.
notes: Reference clip is ~14.5s of clean Voyager-era dialogue ending mid-phrase at 'I am'. Whisper auto-transcribed the truncated tail as 'I am scheduled to take a look at this video' (zero-duration words = hallucinated fill). Trimmed reference_text to the two complete sentences to avoid (text, audio) misalignment in the cloning conditioning.
